transcription.heave_definition: double-amplitude heave divided by crest-to-trough wave height, equal to heave amplitude / wave amplitude
transcription.pitch_definition: double-amplitude pitch divided by 2*pi*H/lambda, equal to pitch amplitude / incident wave-slope amplitude
transcription.acceleration_definition: reported positive peak above still-water zero-g baseline

calm_water_supporting_source.provenance_role: Secondary transcription of experimental Wetted Length and trim from Begovic and Bertorello 2012; the unqualified Wetted Length in Table 5.2 is interpreted as Savitsky mean wetted length because the adjacent prediction and error columns explicitly compare the Savitsky method; trim independently agrees with Begovic et al. 2014 Table 3

transcription.uncertainty: Absolute RAO uncertainty is max(0.01, four vertical pixels converted with the figure ordinate scale).

diagnostic_only: trough-to-peak bow acceleration with possible nonlinear impact contribution

fridsma_linear_gate_definition: lambda/L >= 4, non-resonant long-wave subset predeclared in benchmark CSV
begovic_running_state_definition: measured running trim from Begovic et al. 2014 Table 3 and measured keel wetted length transcribed in Javaherian 2021 Table 5.2 from Begovic and Bertorello 2012
begovic_peak_definition: three-point quadratic experimental peak plus 241-point model scan; experimental prominence must exceed digitization uncertainty
bow_acceleration_role: retained nonlinear impact diagnostic; CG acceleration is the linear hard metric
